description: This file contains unit tests for the onboarding flow logic in an Android application, specifically testing the conditions under which onboarding can be finished based on the connection statuses of operator and node.

classes.name: OnboardingFlowLogicTest
classes.description: Test class for onboarding flow logic conditions.

methods.name: blocksFinishWhenOnlyOperatorIsConnected
methods.description: Test that onboarding cannot finish when only the operator is connected.

methods.name: blocksFinishWhenDisconnected
methods.description: Test that onboarding cannot finish when neither operator nor node is connected.

methods.name: blocksFinishWhenOnlyNodeIsConnected
methods.description: Test that onboarding cannot finish when only the node is connected.

methods.name: allowsFinishOnlyWhenOperatorAndNodeAreConnected
methods.description: Test that onboarding can finish only when both operator and node are connected.
